text: 经历近半年深度回调，国际金价迎来强势反攻，8月7日伦敦现货黄金再度站上4300美元/盎司，此前一日更是录得下半年最大单日涨幅。伴随价格回暖，资金加速布局国内黄金ETF，7月以来主流产品合计净流入超百亿元，黄金ETF华安更创下连续18个交易日净流入的纪录。回顾此轮行情，金价自年内高点最大回撤超26%，流动性环境变化成为调整主因；在全球央行持续购金的支撑下，机构判断黄金短期或延续磨底，长期牛市基础并未动摇。
text_en: After nearly six months of deep correction, international gold prices have staged a strong rebound. On August 7, London spot gold re-stood above $4,300/oz, with the prior day recording the largest single-day gain of H2. With prices recovering, capital has accelerated into domestic gold ETFs, with mainstream products seeing net inflows exceeding 10 billion yuan since July, and Huaan Gold ETF setting a record of 18 consecutive days of net inflows. Looking back at this round, gold prices fell over 26% from their 2026 high, with liquidity environment changes being the main driver; supported by continued global central bank gold purchases, institutions judge gold may continue bottoming short-term, but the long-term bull market foundation remains intact.
